patch.summary:
Choose ADP Workforce Now only if your buying job matches “Mid-market payroll + HR (Select / Plus / Premium packaging) — custom PEPM quote; no publis” rather than HiBob's shape. Choose HiBob only if your buying job matches “Culture-forward mid-market HRIS (Bob Core + modules) — custom PEPM quote; no published sea” rather than ADP Workforce Now's shape. Workflow advantage: ADP Workforce Now leans payroll-benefits; HiBob leans core-hris. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: ADP Workforce Now is Mid-market payroll + HR (Select / Plus / Premium packaging) — custom PEPM quote; no published seat $. Landscape vs Gusto.; HiBob is Culture-forward mid-market HRIS (Bob Core + modules) — custom PEPM quote; no published seat dollars; AI Companion included in Core..
- Workflow coverage skew: ADP Workforce Now-leaning payroll-benefits vs HiBob-leaning core-hris.
- Researched limits: ADP Workforce Now — No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras; HiBob — No published PEPM — implementation and modules dominate TCO.

Limitations — ADP Workforce Now: No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras; Time, talent, and benefits depth live on Plus/Premium or add-ons; HiBob: No published PEPM — implementation and modules dominate TCO; No free plan or self-serve trial.
